title: genetics agent CLI payloads
description: Every JSON document the agent read and search commands print, and the error document a failing command prints under --json. Each document names its payload and this version under `schema`. Rules for readers and for changes, and which commands print the error document: docs/agent_schema.md.

x-payloads.name: error
x-payloads.command: a failing command with --json (docs/agent_schema.md lists them)

runs.list.description: Every directory under the runs root, newest first. A damaged or newer-format run is a row with a status, not a failure.

root.description: The runs directory that was listed.

verified.description: Whether payload digests and deep checks were repeated (--verify). When false, `readable` means the manifest parsed and its files are present, not that they are intact.

incomplete.description: Staging directories left by interrupted saves. They hold no run; `genetics runs prune` removes them.

run_id.description: The id the interrupted save was claiming. It is still free.

runs.show.description: One saved run in full: the frozen record and nothing this engine adds, apart from the envelope (`schema`, `run_id`, `path`). About 1 GB on an imputed run; prefer runs.section or runs.card.

recorded_run_id.description: The id the manifest recorded when the run was saved. It differs from `run_id` only when the bundle directory was renamed.

ancestry.description: The ancestry stage's record: `population`, `mt`, `y`, `ancient`, and from format 18 `reference_population`. Null for a bundle older than format 3: not recorded, which is different from not run.

clinvar.description: The ClinVar reference lookup, with its own `schema_version` (docs/clinvar_coverage.md, docs/secondary_findings.md). Null before format 7. `genetics runs clinvar` and `runs secondary` print it.

pgx.description: Saved pharmacogenomic calls, with their own `schema_version` (docs/pgx_calling.md). Null before format 19. `genetics pgx calls` prints them.

hla.description: Saved HLA classifier evidence, with its own `schema_version` (docs/hla_imputation.md). Null before format 21. `genetics hla calls` prints it.

imputation_provenance.description: Full imputation provenance: `schema_version`, `status`, `stage` (docs/imputation_provenance.md). Null before format 16.

runs.section.description: The saved cards of the requested sections, with what the dashboard shows around them.

sections.description: The requested sections, once each, in AGENTS.md 3.1 order whatever order they were asked in.

cards.description: Those sections' saved cards, in saved order. No card is left out for its confidence.

sections.description: One entry per requested section, in the order of `sections`. A section with no cards is still reported, with its reason.

runs.card.description: One saved card in full, with the current context a reader of it needs.

citation_links.description: One entry per entry of `card.citations`, in the same order.

url.description: The citation's public page. Null when this engine will not link the saved citation.

related.description: Cards held by other sections that this card's section points to. They are the section's pointers, not the card's own.

pointed_from.description: Sections whose pointers name this card.

runs.qc.description: A saved run's QC report, imputation execution record and provenance. Holds no genotype.

imputation_provenance_status.description: `recorded` when full imputation provenance was saved, another status when it was not, null before format 16. `genetics runs imputation <run>` prints the record.

cards.evidence.description: What a knowledge-pack card rests on. It reads no run and holds no genotype, so it is the payload to research a card from (AGENTS.md 1.3). Outcome text is left out: it is a template with the reader's genotype still to be filled in.

variants.description: Every variant the card reads. Empty for a card that matches no marker.

evidence.description: The card-level published claim. Null for an assay-limit card and for a computed card, which states `method_evidence` instead.

outcome_evidence.description: Outcomes that set their own evidence, by outcome name. Null means no phenotype estimate applies to that outcome.

polygenic.description: The score a polygenic card computes. Null for every other kind.

decile_outcomes.description: Absolute outcome rates by score decile, where a source publishes them (AGENTS.md 4.5).

hla.description: An HLA card's authored selector: `alternatives`, `states`, and optionally `phase` and `cpic` (docs/hla_cards.md). Null for every other kind.

carrier.description: A carrier card's declaration (docs/carrier_status.md). Null when the card declares none.

computation.description: The name of the computation a computed card reports. Null for every other kind.

method_evidence.description: Evidence for a computed card's method, in place of a per-variant effect.

impossibility_reason.description: Why the assay cannot determine this (AGENTS.md 3.2). Such a card cites nothing.

url.description: The citation's public page, or null when none is linked.

runs.search.description: The saved cards of one run that match a query, best first, each with its saved face. The ranking is made when the run is read, so everything about it is under `current_context`. No card is ranked or left out for its status or confidence tier.

results.description: The matched cards as the run saved them, best first. Each is eight keys of the saved card; `genetics runs card` prints the rest.

hits.description: One entry per entry of `results`, in the same order: why that card matched.

cards.search.description: The knowledge-pack cards that match a query, best first. It reads no run and holds no genotype, so it is the payload to find a card id from (AGENTS.md 1.3). A query that reads as a genotype is refused with kind `genotype-in-query`.

hits.description: The matched cards, best first: by terms matched, then score, then the pack's own order.

card_id.description: The id `genetics cards evidence` and `genetics runs card` take.

error.description: What a command prints on stdout when it fails under --json. The exit code is non-zero.

kind.description: A stable name to branch on. docs/agent_schema.md lists the kinds each read command gives. `genetics run` gives two with an underscore.

message.description: A sentence for a person. Do not parse it.

run_id.description: The bundle's directory name, which is the id every command resolves and `runs list` prints.

run_path.description: Where the bundle is on this machine.

format_version.description: The bundle format the run was saved in. It versions the saved record; `schema.version` versions this document.

created_at.description: When the run was saved, as the manifest recorded it (UTC, ISO 8601).

card_status.description: `matched` and `computed` are findings. Every other status says why the card has no finding for this run.

confidence_tier.description: The reliability tier a card shows on its face. A label, never a filter (AGENTS.md 0.1A).

run_status.description: `future-version` is intact and needs the version of the tool that wrote it. `damaged` could not be read.

search_field.description: Where in a card a query term was found. `variant` is an rsID the card reads, never a call at it. `summary` is the card face: in the pack, any outcome's; in a saved run, the one that run recorded.

search_query.description: The query as it was given, with runs of whitespace collapsed.

search_terms.description: The words searched for: the query lowercased and split into runs of letters and digits, once each, in the query's order.

search_ignored.description: Common words dropped from the query, such as `of` and `the`. Empty when the query held nothing else, in which case they are searched.

search_total.description: How many cards matched at least one term. More than the hits listed when `limit` cut the list.

search_limit.description: The --limit given, or null when every match is listed.

search_score.description: Field weight times match quality, summed over the terms, plus half a field's weight where the whole query appears side by side in it. It orders the hits of one search and means nothing across searches. docs/agent_cli.md gives the weights.

search_terms_matched.description: How many of `terms` the card matched. Hits are ordered by this first.

search_matched.description: Each field that matched, with the terms it matched in the query's order.

card_face.description: What a saved card shows before it is opened: eight keys of `stored_card`, with the same meanings. Frozen: this engine adds nothing to it. `summary` states the reader's result.

run_summary.description: One run directory. Every field except `run_id`, `path` and `status` is null when the manifest could not supply it.

detail.description: Why the run is not readable, or a note about a readable one.

variant.description: A marker, keyed as AGENTS.md 2 requires: position and alleles on GRCh37, forward strand.

match.description: How the card's criteria met this genome. This block states the reader's genotype.

reason.description: Why the card has this status.

genotype.description: The call the outcome was chosen by, sorted, on the card's strand.

observed_genotype.description: The call as the export gave it, sorted.

confidence.description: The computed confidence of an interpretation or HLA card: the tier and every input that produced it. Computed, polygenic and guideline cards keep theirs in `computation.reliability` instead.

inputs.description: Six scored inputs, each with the value that was scored. A null value from format 12 on means no phenotype estimate applies to the outcome.

empirical_ppv.description: The measured share of such chip calls that sequencing confirmed, for a likely-artifact call in a band that has one.

evidence.description: A published claim: what was measured, in whom, and how large.

ancestry.description: The populations the estimate came from.

within_family_attenuation.description: The share of the population-level effect that remains within families, where a source reports it (AGENTS.md 4.5).

context.description: What the number is a measure of, in a sentence.

observation.description: How the call entered the engine. Present even when the card has no finding.

imputation.description: The imputed dosage evidence behind an imputed call (format 15 on; docs/imputation_quality.md).

citation.description: A saved citation. Every interpretation card has at least one; an assay-limit card has none.

id.description: The DOI, PMID, PMCID, accession or URL itself.

database.description: The database an accession belongs to.

computation.description: The record behind a computed, polygenic, guideline or HLA card.

source.description: Which computation: `polygenic_score`, `pgx_guideline`, `hla_card`, or a computed card's source such as `long_roh`.

reason.description: Why the computation did not run. Null when it did.

result.description: The measured record, in the shape its source documents. A guideline card from format 26 on holds a reference to the run's PGx record instead of a copy.

reliability.description: Where computed, polygenic and guideline cards keep their tier and what produced it. `score`, `inputs`, `ceilings` and `genes` are present where the source computes them.

method_evidence.description: Evidence for the method, in place of a per-variant effect.

stored_card.description: One card as the run saved it. Every key is always present; a key the bundle's format did not have is null. Frozen: this engine adds nothing to it.

confidence_tier.description: The card's tier, from `confidence.tier` or `computation.reliability.tier`. Null when the card has no finding or states an assay limit.

summary.description: The claim on the card face, with the reader's result filled in.

variant.description: The marker a single-marker card reads. Null for a card that reads none or several.

evidence.description: Null for an assay-limit card, for an outcome with no phenotype estimate, and for every card of a format 1 bundle.

confidence_frequency.description: The frequency the confidence calculation used.

multi_marker.description: A card read from several markers: its own `schema_version`, each marker's observation, and the haplotypes or diplotypes they support.

risk_context.description: The absolute risk beside a relative one, on a matched card that states one.

imputation_mode.description: The run's imputation mode (format 14 on; docs/imputation_mode.md).

ancestry_comparison.description: How the run's ancestry placement compares with the study population (format 18 on; docs/card_ancestry.md). `text` states it.

carrier.description: A carrier card's declaration and derived `state` (format 24 on; docs/carrier_status.md).

pointer.description: A pointer a section declares to a card another section holds, resolved against this run.

in_run.description: False for a run saved before the card existed.

section.description: The section that holds the card. Null when `in_run` is false.

section_context.description: What the dashboard shows around one section's cards.

empty_reason.description: Why the section shows no finding. Null when it shows one.

saved_records.description: Saved records beyond the cards, with the command that prints each.

section_framing.description: Pharmacogenomics only: the section's standing notice (docs/pgx_framing.md).

carrier_scope.description: Reproductive only: the statement that the section is not a carrier screen. Null when the run holds no carrier card.

qc.description: The saved QC report (qc.run.json), as the engine that saved the run wrote it. Read it defensively: another version may have written fewer fields. Today's writer gives `vendor`, `call_rates`, `heterozygosity`, `sex`, `build`, `duplicates`, `indels`, `het_haploid_calls`, `source_path` and `warnings`.

sex.description: `inferred`, and the X heterozygosity and Y call rate behind it.

build.description: `declared` and the `verdict` of the anchor check.

warnings.description: Every QC warning, in QC's order.

imputation.description: The imputation execution record: `schema_version`, `mode`, `status`, `card_input`, `summary` (docs/imputation_mode.md). Null before format 14.

knowledge.description: The knowledge pack by content: `card_schema_version`, `card_count`, a `digest` over the card files, and each file's digest.

references.description: `present`, `reason`, and each reference source's `version` and `license` under `sources`.
